title: Persistent cloud-first brain and UI awakening
task:
Build a provider-portable, cloud-first Mahoraga runtime. Package the authoritative core and workspace as one long-running OCI service with durable state and a supervised low-duty idle loop. Replace manual PC pairing as the default UI path with an authenticated same-origin cloud gateway; keep Windows and the encrypted relay as optional accelerators. Permit a configured cloud model under explicit request, concurrency, and spend ceilings. Keep Vercel preview-only and add one viable paid always-on deployment profile outside Vercel.

Acceptance criteria:
- The container starts and supervises core plus UI, mounts durable state, and has bounded liveness/readiness endpoints.
- A documented provider profile disables scale-to-zero and attaches persistent storage.
- UI startup probes automatically and shows Connecting, Idle, Awake, Degraded, or Offline; the cloud path needs no pasted offer.
- Owner authentication, CSRF/replay protection, and an allowlisted gateway keep all provider, GitHub, and runtime secrets server-side.
- Idle health invokes no model; user work can use the configured cloud model only within hard limits.
- Local Windows execution remains optional through the encrypted relay.
- Tests cover startup/restart, reload, denied auth, provider failure, and idle-to-awake behavior.
- Docs separate code-complete behavior from provider billing, secrets, DNS, deployment, and rollback steps.

Skill profile: Auto-route within repository.
Source workspace issue: https://github.com/michaeljwilliams0123/mahoraga/issues/271. Repository-safe attachment references remain in that issue and are not copied into the coordination record.
